verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs show remote state storage in the managed Pulumi Cloud backend or a self-managed object store (AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage), and a community comment confirms a managed state service with a self-managed option. Nothing in the pack mentions state locking or protection against concurrent updates, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of state locking or concurrency protection for either backend type, and independent hands-on corroboration of safe concurrent runs.
